extracted.description: Precise orbital data (SP3) for satellite Swarm-A must be available and resolvable to a geodetic position for every timepoint in the analysis window.
Analysis is restricted to the exact time window September 2 to September 29, 2019 (inclusive) and to Swarm-A only.

At each timepoint, geopotential energy per unit mass is computed by interpolating the mock geopotential field defined over latitude, longitude, and altitude at the satellite's geodetic position, expressed in J/kg.
Physical constants are fixed by the request and must be used exactly as specified.
The mean geopotential energy per unit mass is the arithmetic average of the per-timepoint values over all valid timepoints in the window.

stored.description: Precise orbital data (SP3) for satellite Swarm-A must be available and resolvable to a geodetic position for every timepoint in the analysis window.
acceptanceCriteria: Orbital data source is SP3 precise orbit files for Swarm-A only
Every timepoint used yields a complete geodetic position (latitude, longitude, altitude)
Timepoints with unresolvable or missing position are excluded and do not silently enter the mean

assertions.description: Precise orbital data (SP3) for satellite Swarm-A must be available and resolvable to a geodetic position for every timepoint in the analysis window.

stored.description: Analysis is restricted to the exact time window September 2 to September 29, 2019 (inclusive) and to Swarm-A only.
acceptanceCriteria: All timepoints fall within 2019-09-02 through 2019-09-29 inclusive
No timepoints outside the window are included in any computation or aggregation
Satellite identity is fixed to Swarm-A; other satellites' data are excluded

assertions.description: Analysis is restricted to the exact time window September 2 to September 29, 2019 (inclusive) and to Swarm-A only.

stored.description: At each timepoint, geopotential energy per unit mass is computed by interpolating the mock geopotential field defined over latitude, longitude, and altitude at the satellite's geodetic position, expressed in J/kg.
acceptanceCriteria: Potential energy per unit mass at each timepoint is obtained by interpolating the given mock geopotential field at the satellite's latitude, longitude, and altitude
Each per-timepoint value is expressed in J/kg
Interpolation uses the field's definition over latitude, longitude, and altitude without substituting a different potential model

assertions.description: At each timepoint, geopotential energy per unit mass is computed by interpolating the mock geopotential field defined over latitude, longitude, and altitude at the satellite's geodetic position, expressed in J/kg.

stored.description: Physical constants are fixed by the request and must be used exactly as specified.
acceptanceCriteria: Earth radius is taken as 6371.0 km in any position/altitude conversion
Gravitational acceleration is taken as g = 9.80665 m/s^2
No alternative values of these constants are substituted anywhere in the computation

assertions.description: Physical constants are fixed by the request and must be used exactly as specified.

stored.description: The mean geopotential energy per unit mass is the arithmetic average of the per-timepoint values over all valid timepoints in the window.
acceptanceCriteria: Mean is computed as the arithmetic average across all valid timepoints in the Sep 2–29, 2019 window
No timepoint subset or reweighting is applied beyond excluding invalid points

assertions.description: The mean geopotential energy per unit mass is the arithmetic average of the per-timepoint values over all valid timepoints in the window.
